What to look for: compare exit status, not just the first line. dxc 1.6.2112
(CE's oldest) fails the exact filed command with a nonzero exit and a fatal
diagnostic pointing at the partially-specialized template's PARAM1 parameter
declaration. dxc_trunk exits 0 and emits a complete SPIR-V module for PSMain,
ending in OpFunctionEnd, with no diagnostic at all.
